startups.name: SilTest
startups.one_liner: AI-powered semiconductor test-program generation and yield analytics for ATE platforms.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Software/AI layer on top of existing ATE infrastructure (Advantest, Teradyne) for test-program generation and yield analytics - not a new physical or architectural approach. Doesn't map cleanly onto co-design, chiplet, or packaging as written in the thesis.

startups.name: UniSCool
startups.one_liner: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling claiming ~50% energy savings over microchannel/jet-impingement cooling.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Evolutionary efficiency gain rather than a new physical principle; academic roots (Universitat de Lleida) and EU public co-funding (NextGenerationEU/CDTI) are the strongest sovereignty signal of any venture in this set. Differentiation depends on IP defensibility vs. incumbents (Vertiv/Eaton/Schneider all bought into this niche in 2025).

startups.name: Finchetto
startups.one_liner: Fully-passive optical network switch for data centers - no electronics in the switch fabric.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Genuine physics-level differentiation: 26-53x power reduction vs conventional switches, 40ns port-to-port latency. UK-based, so outside EU Chips Act/IPCEI/EuroHPC instruments - sovereign path would run through Innovate UK and direct hyperscaler contracts.

startups.name: Rayd Technologies
startups.one_liner: Photonic neuromorphic AI processor embedding learning dynamics into hardware physics.
startups.country: United Kingdom (Imperial College London; EPFL support)
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Combines a new substrate (photonics) and a new architecture (neuromorphic) simultaneously - the strongest architectural story in this dataset. >100x fewer parameters claimed for on-device, low-data inference. Same UK/Swiss sovereignty caveat as Finchetto.

startups.name: Quobly
startups.one_liner: Silicon spin-qubit quantum computing, CMOS-compatible manufacturing path.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: CEA-Leti/CNRS spinout; STMicroelectronics involvement gives a credible CMOS-compatible manufacturing story, not just lab-scale physics. Already past cohort stage - useful as a market-validation reference, not a sourcing target.
source_urls: referenced in prior incubator research (compass_artifact doc); verify directly before citing funding figure

startups.name: planqc
startups.one_liner: Neutral-atom quantum computing hardware.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Strong investor signal - Amadeus APEX Technology Fund invested with Hermann Hauser (ARM co-founder) taking a board seat. Funding amount not independently verified here.

startups.name: Swave Photonics
startups.one_liner: Photonic holographic/XR spatial light modulator chip.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Genuine photonic hardware innovation, but the application is holographic AR/VR display, not general compute - borderline fit for a compute thesis specifically. Included for completeness; flag this distinction if citing it.

startups.name: QuantWare
startups.one_liner: Superconducting quantum processor manufacturer building an industrial-scale fab (KiloFab).
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Largest private round yet for a dedicated quantum-processor company; led by Intel Capital, In-Q-Tel, ETF Partners. Too large/late for a cohort - market-validation reference for the physics_substrate layer.

startups.name: Qblox
startups.one_liner: Quantum control electronics - the hardware layer that operates qubits.
startups.stage: unknown (Project HAVIK participant, EUR 1M KvW-funded consortium)
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Maps directly onto the 'trusted control' bottleneck the live CDL-NGC site names but the written thesis annex doesn't. Funding stage not independently verified beyond the shared consortium grant.

startups.name: Quside
startups.one_liner: Quantum random-number generation hardware for encryption and quantum-safe security.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: ICFO spinout with genuine device-physics IP. Quantum-safe hardware roots of trust is a real, near-term EU procurement line, not speculative science.

startups.name: Openchip & Software Technologies
startups.one_liner: RISC-V processors and accelerators for data centers and HPC, spun from BSC and GTD.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: IPCEI-backed national champion status via Spain's SETT vehicle (Recovery Plan). Real proof the RISC-V sovereignty thesis is fundable in 2026, but too mature and state-anchored to be a cohort candidate.

startups.name: SiPearl
startups.one_liner: Sovereign European HPC processor (Rhea1, 80-core Arm Neoverse V1) for the JUPITER exascale system.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: The clearest single proof-point that European sovereign silicon is fundable at scale in 2026 - backed partly by the EIC Fund. Not incubator-affiliated in the tracked network; included as market context.

startups.name: Axelera AI
startups.one_liner: Chiplet-based AI inference accelerator for scale deployment.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Part of the EUR 240M DARE project (EU chiplet-based HPC stack, led by BSC). $250M+ raised led by Innovation Industries with BlackRock participation - too late-stage for a cohort, validates the chiplet/AI-accelerator thesis.
source_urls: semiengineering.com Q1 2026 startup funding roundup - verify directly before citing

startups.name: enclaive
startups.one_liner: Zero-code-change confidential computing across clouds via a secure-enclave platform.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Maps closely to the thesis's own 'attested inference, confidential compute' language. Differentiation is in the trust/attestation layer rather than new silicon - probe this at diligence. Amadeus APEX Technology Fund (Hermann Hauser's fund) co-led the round.

startups.name: PoliCloud
startups.one_liner: Sovereign HPC cloud infrastructure for European public-sector buyers.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Infrastructure/hosting layer rather than a trust layer - complementary to enclaive rather than competing with it. Focused explicitly on EU public-entity customers.

startups.name: Arkeon
startups.one_liner: Post-fabrication precision tuning of superconducting quantum chip qubit frequencies to improve yield.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Founded 2025 (Peter Horstedt, Andreas Nylander, Marcus Rommel). Addresses a real manufacturing bottleneck in superconducting quantum chips (qubit frequency variance from fabrication) rather than building a new compute paradigm from scratch - narrower, more defensible claim than a lot of quantum hardware pitches.

startups.name: FrostByte
startups.one_liner: Cryogenic control electronics that operate alongside quantum processors at ultra-low temperatures.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: QuTech/TU Delft spinout addressing the 'trusted control' / cryo-electronics bottleneck the live CDL-NGC site names explicitly - a scaling constraint for every quantum hardware company, not just one architecture. Raised May 2026, led by InnovationQuarter Capital.
source_urls: referenced via quantum-hardware funding research Aug 2026; verify current terms directly before citing

startups.name: Vivid Photonics
startups.one_liner: Horizontal Cavity Surface Emitting Super Luminescent Diode (SLD) technology for AR/VR image quality.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Genuine photonic device innovation (claimed first-of-its-kind SLD geometry), but the application is AR/VR display rather than general compute - same borderline-fit caveat as Swave Photonics. Tyndall spinout, selected for ChipStart EU (Europe's first semiconductor-specific incubator).

startups.name: PulpoSemi
startups.one_liner: Integrated voltage regulators (IVRs) with high current density for AI system power management.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Directly addresses the power-delivery layer this project's taxonomy elevates beyond the written CDL-NGC thesis's packaging footnote - power management silicon for high-density AI compute, not a downstream software layer.

startups.name: Endurance Semiconductors
startups.one_liner: Wide-bandgap power semiconductors cutting switching losses up to 50% for AI data centers, EVs, and grids.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Wide-bandgap is a compound-semiconductor substrate approach (named directly in the physics_substrate layer definition), applied to the power-delivery problem - one of the cleanest double-layer fits in this dataset.

startups.name: AEROLYTICS
startups.one_liner: Indoor autonomous drones that monitor greenhouse crops, reducing pesticide use while boosting yield and crop health.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: AEROLYTICS builds autonomous drones with integrated sensors and AI, but it does not introduce a new compute architecture or substrate; it is a hardware platform that applies existing compute technology to a new application domain.

startups.name: AETECH
startups.one_liner: Innovative medical device that integrates with ECMO systems to provide intelligent, real‑time therapy adjustments.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: AETECH delivers a medical device that embeds AI for real‑time therapy adjustments; it is a hardware solution but does not represent a new compute architecture or substrate beyond conventional silicon.

startups.name: COMMON SENSE ROBOTICS
startups.one_liner: AI‑driven digitisation, integration and automation of manual touch‑labour in manufacturing, streamlining task management.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: COMMON SENSE ROBOTICS provides robotic hardware with embedded AI for automation; it does not introduce a new compute architecture or substrate, merely applying existing technology to a new domain.

startups.name: LYNQO
startups.one_liner: Technology that improves surgical‑instrument management in hospitals, reducing workload, cost and environmental impact.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: LYNQO offers a hardware‑centric solution for surgical‑instrument tracking; it does not present a new compute architecture or substrate, but rather adapts existing technology to a medical workflow.

startups.name: STIMALIA
startups.one_liner: Miniaturised, injectable bio‑electronic implant that provides continuous, drug‑free PTSD therapy via long‑lasting nerve stimulation.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: STIMALIA develops a bio‑electronic implant; while it is a novel hardware device, it does not introduce a new compute architecture or substrate beyond conventional silicon, but rather applies existing electronics to a medical application.
